name: DrillerDB
tagline: Run drilling operations from Cline with secure access to jobs, customers, schedules, invoices, and well logs
description: Connect Cline to your DrillerDB company through the managed first-party MCP server. Use 45 tools to inspect projects, customers, proposals, invoices, schedules, crews, equipment, field reports, and well logs. Every request is OAuth-authenticated, tenant-scoped, rate-limited, and audit-logged; higher-risk writes require human approval in DrillerDB before they run.

install.notes: Sign in with your existing DrillerDB account when Cline opens the OAuth authorization flow. Access is limited to your own DrillerDB company and can be revoked at any time.
